title: AI Raises The Bar For B2B Personalization, Again
summary: Learn how AI helps B2B marketers move beyond one-off personalization tactics to deliver more relevant, buyer-focused experiences.
body_markdown:
Personalized emails, account-specific landing pages, and customized offers can create relevance, but personalization in isolation won’t meet the needs of empowered, AI-assisted B2B buyers.


B2B buyers and customers expect providers to understand their goals, recognize their context, and deliver relevant experiences throughout the buying journey and


[postsale experience](https://www.forrester.com/blogs/personalization-makes-every-postsale-journey-your-b2b-customers-own/) . Companies that cannot deliver on those expectations risk forfeiting conversion, acquisition, and expansion opportunities while losing relevance and influence in increasingly digital and AI-mediated buying journeys.


B2B marketers face mounting pressure to deliver content and digital experiences that are relevant, valuable, and influence both human and AI audiences. Yet despite widespread utilization, many B2B companies struggle to mature personalization beyond isolated tactics. Instead, they create experiences that feel generic, disconnected, or focused on the seller rather than the buyer.


## Personalizing An Asset Or Delivery Mechanism Isn’t Enough


As buyers move from exploring a problem to building consensus and justifying a decision, their information needs change. Personalized experiences must adapt accordingly in the moment of need.


B2B personalization should respond to the buyer’s context and information questions, reducing complexity early in the journey. As purchase decisions progress, personalization must continue to support consensus, business justification, and commitment. This requires a combination of personalization techniques, decisioning, and orchestration capabilities that are audience-led, channel-independent, and AI-enabled.


B2B marketers


[most commonly](https://www.forrester.com/report/the-forrester-b2b-personalization-deployment-model/RES172065) use segment-based targeting, personalize for personas, and personalize based on behavior. Personalization based on buyer need is most impactful but not among the topmost


utilized techniques.


Effective B2B personalization approaches combine audience-centric design, buying group awareness, signal activation, connected content, and composable experiences. The resulting interaction experiences are contextual, conditional, and increasingly conversational to help increase relevance, influence decisions, and drive customer value.


## Use AI To Close The Gap Between Content Generation And Real-Time Personalization


[Forrester’s Marketing Survey, 2026](https://www.forrester.com/data-and-insights/surveys/forresters-marketing-survey-2026/SUS191349) found that 88% of B2B marketing leaders say personalization is an AI use case in full production, pilot, proof of concept, or experimentation phase.


Content creation continues to be a leading AI use case for B2B personalization. In Forrester’s B2B Marketing Online Community B2B Summit Survey, March 2026, 71% of respondents said they use AI to generate or adapt content variations for different audiences or contexts. Yet only 23% use AI to assemble or adapt experiences in real time based on interaction context, intent, and signals.


The broader opportunity to capture value from AI spanning B2B personalization workflows includes:


- Delivering contextual relevance in the moment of interaction.
- Capturing new signals from the content that audiences consume and the actions they take.
- Using those signals to inform more meaningful personalization of the next interaction.


## Putting B2B Personalization In Context


AI can expand and accelerate capabilities in each of the B2B personalization competency areas of strategy, data, design, delivery, and measurement. It’s a path toward moving beyond static segmentation, planned content sequences, and delivery mechanism silos. The result? Dynamically personalized, buying group-aware experiences that reflect real-time buyer behaviors.


Agentic AI expands the B2B personalization playbook through shared context, memory, autonomy, and collaboration across digital marketing workflows. This[changes how work gets done](https://www.forrester.com/blogs/the-future-of-b2b-gtm-isnt-human-versus-ai/) and how buyers engage. Agentic AI also enables new personalization channels and modalities like conversational websites and avatars, effectively combining individualized knowledge with its delivery mechanism.


For all the new capabilities and innovation opportunities AI brings to B2B personalization, its fundamental goal remains unchanged: to deliver the most relevant information and experience in the moment of interaction based on who the audience is, where they are in their journey, and what they’re trying to accomplish.
